title: spermacoce reflexa
intro: Spermacoce reflexa, commonly known as Buttonbush Vine or Yellow Buttonbush, is a tropical plant species that belongs to the Rubiaceae family. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including the treatment of fever, rheumatism, and respiratory issues. The therapeutic actions of Spermacoce reflexa include anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and antimicrobial properties, which may help alleviate symptoms associated with these conditions. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
